concepts.title: Topics covered
concepts.text_md:
- Group Choice: Splunk or AWS Lambda or YAML Deep Dive
- DevSecOps: Trivy vulnerability scanning SonarQube quality
- AWS DevOps native services: CodePipeline CodeBuild CodeDeploy
- Azure DevOps Advanced pipelines and artifacts
- GitHub Actions CI/CD — YAML pipeline from scratch
- Kafka Introduction or GitLab CI/CD or N8n Automation

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- GitHub Actions YAML is free CI/CD directly in GitHub — no Jenkins server required
- DevSecOps shifts security left — scan code and containers before reaching production
- AWS Lambda plus EventBridge creates event-driven architecture without any servers
- N8n is open-source automation with 400 plus integrations — the open-source Zapier
- GitLab combines Git plus CI/CD plus Registry plus Security scanning in one platform
